Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Appreciate the commitment to a 12-month minimum; that makes a few paths possible. Two draft options for your procurement team to consider:

Option A — Amortized platform fee (Preferred)
- Platform fee invoiced quarterly but amortized in our invoice schedule over 12 months (4 equal installments).
- One-time implementation credit: $45,000 applied across months 1–3 as a straight offset to monthly invoices.
- Support: Standard (included), Premier (adds 24/7 response + 4 on-call hours / month) at +15% of monthly fee, Enterprise (SLA + dedicated SRE) priced separately.
- Usage protection: if average monthly token consumption across months 10–12 is < 40% of forecasted committed usage, the parties will enter a usage remediation plan (see SOW).

Option B — Upfront platform fee with larger credit
- Full platform fee at start, but a larger implementation credit of $70,000 applied across the first 6 months.
- Support tiers same as above.

Attached: SOW-draft-v0.2.pdf and Support-table.csv.

We can also do a blended installment variant (half up front, half amortized). If you prefer, we can build the amortization schedule into the SOW and present a DocuSign package.

Next steps: I'll pull legal in to draft a redline for your team once you confirm which option you prefer. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk the amortization math.
